description: This file defines the ChainLoader class which implements the LoaderInterface for Twig templating. It manages a collection of loaders, delegating template loading tasks such as retrieving source context, checking existence, cache key, and freshness to the appropriate loaders, and caching certain results.

classes.name: ChainLoader
classes.description: A loader that combines multiple other loaders to find and load templates.

methods.name: addLoader
methods.description: Adds a new loader to the chain.

methods.name: getLoaders
methods.description: Returns the array of loaders managed by this chain.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the source context for a given template name, iterating over loaders.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a template exists in any of the loaders.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Gets the cache key for a template, searching through loaders.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Checks if a template is still fresh based on a timestamp.
